featured_reviews.name: Commander Rajiv Kubal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sanjay Padhye - Prabhat Studio – Capturing Memories with Excellence for Over 33 Years.

For more than four decades, Prabhat Studio in Borivali West has been our trusted family photographer, capturing cherished moments with unmatched skill and precision. Today, I had the pleasure of visiting the studio again to get photos for our defense ID cards, and once more, he exceeded expectations.

His attention to detail and dedication to perfecting each shot reflect true artistry. Whether it's for personal portraits, wedding photography, or special events, Prabhat Studio consistently delivers high-quality results with creativity and professionalism.

His ability to make every client feel at ease during shoots and his eye for capturing timeless memories make him a standout in the field. If you are looking for a photographer who blends tradition with modern expertise, Prabhat Studio is the ideal choice. I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone seeking exceptional photography services.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Palve
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid Prabhat Studio for your photo shoot!

We had been there for photo shoot of my 10 month old baby boy. The photographer's ego and attitude were unbearable from the start. Despite not having an appointment, he made us feel inferior and insisted on booking but let us in eventually after throwing his tantrums at us which showed that he was available but god knows what was the fuss all about, maybe he himself needed an ego massage from us. He refused to show us the pictures, promising to edit them later. The pricing was exorbitant and undisclosed until after the shoot. The average picture quality and amateurish editing were disappointing. The photographer showed no respect for his art or customers. Don't waste your time, money, or self-respect here. Seek a more professional and value-driven studio instead.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Shah (webslayer)
featured_reviews.review_text:
This studio is not just a place to get your photos taken; it's a hub of creativity and professionalism that caters to all your photography needs.

Expert Photography: The photographers at Colour King are true artists. They have an exceptional eye for detail and a knack for capturing the perfect moment. Whether it was a candid shot or a posed portrait, each picture they took was a masterpiece. Their understanding of lighting and angles brought out the best in every subject.

State-of-the-Art Editing: Post-photography, the magic of their editing skills came into play. The team at Colour King is adept at using the latest software to enhance photos without losing their natural charm. They skillfully balanced colors, adjusted brightness, and added subtle effects that made each photo pop.

Customized Physical Albums: What truly sets Colour King apart is their customized album service. They offer a range of high-quality albums that you can tailor to your preferences. The quality of the album materials is top-notch, ensuring that your memories are preserved in the best way possible. The layout and design of the albums are done with great care, reflecting a personal touch that resonates with your style.

Customer Service: The staff at Colour King are not only talented but also incredibly friendly and accommodating. They took the time to understand my needs and preferences, making sure that the final product was exactly what I wanted. Their patience and willingness to go the extra mile for customer satisfaction were commendable.

Affordable Pricing: Despite the high quality of their services, Colour King offers very reasonable pricing. It's a great value for money considering the level of expertise and quality of the final products.
